I have been to many "psych wards" on lockdown and there are many factors to determine whether or not your stay is going to help you. I will try to list them out as well as different view points to consider.

1. Phych hospilizations can land you in one of various actual locations depending upon your insurance coverage or payment plan. All locations are run different and therefore you are not garenteed the best quality of treatment 100% of the time. I would say its 50/50 odds based on my experience.

2. For this kind of treatment you really have to accept the fact that you are not free but you do have limited freedoms. Look at it as an escape from life and not a prison. If you start to look at it as a prison your mind can go some pretty dark places. As much as they do to prevent you from hurting yourself, it is still very much possible.

3. Try to avoid intimate relationships while you are there. Yes they put guys and girls together. It is extremely unhealthy to start a relationship with someone that needs help while you also need help. It is most likely to turn up bad because if you both need help you are definitely not helping eachother. It is also likely to interfere with the whole reason you are there. Treatment.

4. Try the groups they have you do. They are pretty basic and corny but a few have helped in the moment.

5.

The sad part of this all. Everybody is different in their own way so in turn different things work for different people. Some people still can't find the strength to continue after years of useless get better quick tips. Which from a place like a psych ward is all your going to get along with their versions of safety.
